latest_findings.description: TSK fls confirms the NTFS USN Journal ($UsnJrnl:$J) is genuinely absent from this Windows XP disk image. Direct inspection of $Extend directory (inode 11, NTFS partition offset sector 63) via fls -o 63 /mnt/evidence/ewf1 11 shows only $ObjId (inode 341), $Quota (inode 340), and $Reparse (inode 342) — no $UsnJrnl entry exists. Windows XP did not enable the USN Change Journal by default; it required explicit administrator enablement (fsutil usn createjournal). This is genuine artifact absence, not a FUSE mount limitation.
